Application Data.NAME: Sunny Side Diner
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Side Diner is a family-oriented fast food restaurant specializing in breakfast and lunch offerings, featuring a diverse menu that includes pancakes, burgers, sandwiches, and fresh salads. Our establishment focuses on providing a welcoming environment with quick service and quality food for families and individuals on the go. We prioritize customer satisfaction and adhere to all health and safety regulations to ensure a safe dining experience.
